title: Weak point Wednesday: Upper chest
summary: NH explains how naturals can build the upper chest, a muscle linked to steroid users. Presses didn't develop his upper and inner chest; light, high-rep supinated band or cable flyes that bring the arms up and in built the mind-muscle connection, and he warns against guillotine presses.
claims: Upper chest, rear delts and traps develop disproportionately on steroids without targeted work
He cares little for chest and shoulders aesthetically but trains everything, and only began targeting upper chest 3-4 months ago
Pressing alone, even overhead press only, may build the upper chest for some frames depending on insertions
The whole chest contracts in any press but certain areas get hit harder; bench built his lower and mid chest, not his upper and inner chest
Mind-muscle connection matters: once you build a pathway with a muscle you can engage it in movements
Incline press doesn't activate upper chest more than flat press when tonnage is equalized
Supinated band or cable flyes raising the arms up and inward hit the upper and inner chest for anyone
Do those flyes in large amounts, light and high rep; the risk is to the shoulder or biceps, not the chest
Over time the flyes give upper chest sensations during presses too
Doing the flyes between bench sets won't take strength away from pressing
Visible upper/lower chest separation depends on how much fat you store there
Push-up variations can bias the upper chest
Avoid guillotine or neck presses for upper chest; shoulder health matters more than upper chest size
Naturals can build a massive upper chest and he intends to prove it
exercises: band under feet, arms supinated, bring up and inside; light high reps
fine if you like it, no special upper chest activation
